notes.title: 🎯 2,500 wishlists: ✅
notes.notes: [p]The station’s on fire (literally, someone messed with the thrusters). We’re fixing that and coming back with the good stuff. Thank you 💫[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“OK, it’s official: we’re SUPERSTARS. I even signed an autograph for a toaster. It got emotional.” – R-V[/i][/p][/quote]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is coming to an end...
notes.notes:
[p]From shattered records to unexpected discoveries (yes, [b][i]that[/i] one[/b] — vive la France 👀), to ships smashing joyfully (and questionably) into walls… you showed up in style.[/p][p][/p][p]⏳ [b]Heads up[/b]: [b]the demo will no longer be available once the Next Fest ends. If you’ve got one last flight to take or a friend to convert: now’s the time. Otherwise, sign up for the playtest 👉 [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471320/THE_RIFT/"]Link to the Steam page[/url][/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“Analysis window closed. Next opening: TBD. Brace yourselves, I’m pulling the plug.” – M1-Shell
“It’s not a tear. It’s a hydraulic leak, alright?” – R-V[/i][/p][/quote]

notes.title: 🎯 2000 wishlists: ✅
notes.notes: [p]2000 people answered the call: and that’s pushing us to go even further. Thank you very much![/p][p][/p][p][i]“That’s more than 1,999, and I like round numbers. Though twisty numbers are fine too — I’m not picky.” – R-V[/i][/p]

notes.title: Call to All Arena Pilots – Day 5
notes.notes:
[h2]Well then?[/h2][p]
The rankings on Campaign1, Campaign2, and Campaign3 remain unchanged today. We're starting to wonder if you're resting on your laurels… or if HyneKro just welded his times directly onto the leaderboard. 👀[/p][p]But today, what really caught our attention were [url=" https://discord.com/invite/GPsqg4qdyW"]two images shared on our Discord[/url]. Two snapshots, tense like a well-executed turn:[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279243/5dc7998049667008e39f5bc2e9d0311fbffd8f73.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Scorpion400 slips past HyneKro on Tutorial 6 in a razor-sharp duel: → 00-09-800 vs. 00-09-832.[/p][p]Yes, we’re talking about a [i][b]32-millisecond difference[/b][/i]. The kind of detail that humbles you.[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279243/c0578c26b07e411ac29ccb5a0e4357c463b552e4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Here, it’s CardamomCake who takes the lead, followed by HyneKro and littledionysus: → 00-06-923 / 00-07-183 / 00-07-318[/p][p] Three approaches, three flight paths. We love to see it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Meanwhile, over 1000 unique pilots have taken flight in [i]The RIFT[/i] on Steam.[/b][/h3][p][b]We see you. And we thank you, deeply. Keep going.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🧠 [b]Pro Tip – The Crab Strafe, or the Art of Spatial Drifting[/b]
Combine your thrusters to get the most out of your ship. Moving forward while climbing is all about angle, rhythm… and smart camera alignment.[/p][quote][p][i]“I’ve seen trajectories worthy of modern art today. Keep it up, you’re weird—but efficient.” – R-V
“Thrust vector optimization: incomplete. Improve camera control.” – M1-Shell[/i][/p][/quote]

But enough sentimentality — it’s time for competition. Here are today’s rankings:[/h3][p]The standings for Campaign1 and Campaign3 remain unchanged (sneaky racers...). However, here are some fresh highlights:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Campaign2[/b]
🥇 RyeRevenTV : 01-09-407 [/p][p]🥈 HyneKro : 01-09-550 [/p][p]🥉 Scorpion400 : 01-14-916[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tuto10 – Graviton[/b]
🥇 tautheory : 00-08-736 [/p][p]🥈 HyneKro : 00-08-756 [/p][p]🥉 Mageever : 00-09-207[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tuto7 – Racing[/b]
🥇 Mageever : 00-03-821 [/p][p]🥈 HyneKro : 00-03-899 [/p][p]🥉 tautheory : 00-03-937[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🧠 [b]Pro Tip – Explore with Photo Mode[/b]
In campaign mode, the spectator/photo mode lets you rise above the map, analyze every angle… and snap some pretty sweet shots.[/p][quote][p][i]"Looking at the map from above is like reading my designer’s mind. Only less scary."[/i] – R-V
[i]"Visual exploration recommended. Improvisation leads to failure."[/i] – M1-Shell[/p][/quote]

notes.title: 🎯 1,600 wishlists: ✅
notes.notes: [p]You keep showing up big time, and let’s be real — it gives us a massive boost. Thanks to everyone supporting, sharing, testing, crashing, and trying again.   [/p][p][/p][p][i]“1,600?! That’s not a number, that’s an INVASION! Alright… just in case, I’m triggering a red alert — let’s hope it doesn’t blow up the coffee machine.” – R-V[/i][/p]

🧠 [b]Pro Tip – Phasing Wall: The Art of the Pass-Through[/b]
The faster you enter, the faster you exit. Plan your approach ahead to keep as much momentum as possible on entry.[/p][p][i]"Come get me, this is never-ending…" – R-V"[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🎯 1,000 wishlists ✅
notes.notes: [p]Huge thanks to everyone who’s jumped on board [i]The RIFT[/i]. This is just the beginning of the journey.[/p][p][/p][p]“WOOHOOO! A thousand! That’s more than the number of bolts I lost this week! We’re famous, folks! FAY-MOUS!!” — R-V[/p]

notes.title: The RIFT enters the stage for the Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p][b]The Steam Next Fest has officially opened, and The RIFT is stepping into the spotlight.[/b][/p][p]You can now download the demo: tutorials, free flight, solo campaign, leaderboard, and… a not-so-well-hidden little something. 👀[/p][p]Check it out here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471320/THE_RIFT/"]Steam page link[/url][/p][p]We’ve worked hard, listened closely during the playtests — now it’s your turn to take the controls. We’ll see you in the arena.[/p][p][/p][p][b]👉 Keep sharing your feedback on the demo over on [url="https://discord.gg/2SgA72nn"]Discord[/url]: every opinion counts and directly helps us refine the game — it’s like a live playtest.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Time to fly fast, shoot straight, and uh… maybe avoid the walls? I’m the one who has to fix 'em, y’know." – R-V[/i][/p]

notes.title: Updates
notes.notes: [p]Since the first playtests, we’ve combed through every inch of the station to improve everything we could: visuals, interface, content, consistency, and overall game feel… In short, The RIFT has evolved a lot in preparation for this Next Fest. [b]Here’s a look at what we’ve already revamped in-depth thanks to you:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Visual and behavioral improvements to all gameplay elements[/p][/*][*][p]A fully reworked main menu background: now set in a spaceship hangar[/p][/*][*][p]A total visual overhaul of maps and assets — mountains, buildings, stations, and scenery — for better coherence and overall environment quality, with more detail in shapes and textures[/p][/*][*][p]A full revamp of the 14 tutorial maps[/p][/*][*][p]1 brand new campaign map, alongside 2 existing ones that have been entirely reworked for the occasion[/p][/*][*][p]In Freefly mode: 3 new environments also featured in the campaign maps (Planet Erida Delta2, Moon Voss, Asteroids Craxis Array)[/p][/*][*][p]Complete overhaul of the main menu interface and all UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]First pass of ship customization (just the beginning — more to come)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Implementation of a player profile[/p][/*][*][p]Early version of player stats integrated into the profile[/p][/*][*][p]Improved in-game HUD: clearer, more informative, without cluttering the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded photo mode[/p][/*][*][p]New soundtrack playlist (temporary placeholder for now)[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visual effects on the ship[/p][/*][*][p]Major optimization pass[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of content uploaded across our social media[/p][/*][*][p]Total redesign of our Steam page visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Brand-new logos and banners for The RIFT[/p][/*][*][p]And a surprise with a very… French touch. Oui oui[/p][/*][/list][p][i]“Are you sure this giant metal thing is even certified for the arena?”[/i]— R-V"[/p]
